w.t: Hath this been in your days

f.t: That which the palmerworm…: Heb. *The residue of the palmerworm*

w.t: and he hath the cheek teeth

f.t: barked…: Heb. *laid my fig tree for a barking*

w.t: also unto thee: for the rivers
the like, neither shall be any more

f.t: of many…: Heb. *of generation and generation*

w.t: They shall run to and fro
to me with all your heart

f.t: rule over: or, *use a byword against*

w.t: therewith: and I will no more make
But I will remove far off
and he will cause to come down

f.t: the former rain moderately: or, *a teacher of righteousness*

w.t: and none else: and my people

p.x: I Will Pour Out My Spirit

w.t: And it shall come to pass afterward
And it shall come to pass, that
with them there for my people
Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre
that ye might remove them far

f.t: the Grecians: Heb. *the sons of the Grecians*
cause…: or, *the Lord shall bring down*

w.t: And it shall come to pass in that day

f.t: for the…: or, *even I the Lord that*
